text:
emma_sales: Quick sync — BlueCrest wants to sign our POC order but procurement is asking for SCCs certs + a DPA redline that tightens deletion to 7 days and removes our right to audit. they also want net45.
todd_legal: 7-day deletion for all backups? that's likely impossible operationally. we can offer 7 days for active customer-owned upload buckets, but backups and cold storage need a 30-day window. also cannot remove audit rights. propose: deletion SLA = 7 days for primary store, 30 days for backups; retain audit clause.
alya_finance: net45 is okay for enterprise if credit approved. need their PO number before provisioning. if they insist on net45 but want earlier access, we can accept a billing commitment email + pre-invoice. otherwise require prepayment.
leo_ps: technical ask — they want a separate ingestion endpoint with encrypted transit + option to scope data to a sandbox tenant. we have that as a configuration but need to note it in the order form appendix so SRE can open a tenant.
emma_sales: they attached a redline where Section 2.4 moves all responsibility for data deletion to vendor and adds a 10M penalty for noncompliance. also they appended "SCC certificates must be provided prior to countersign".
todd_legal: reject blanket transfer of data deletion responsibility. counterproposal: keep responsibilities as-is; add Service Level: deletion initiation within 7 business days for active data, full deletion confirmation within 30 days for retained backups. cap on deletion penalty tied to POC fees, not unlimited — suggest cap = 2x fees or $50k whichever is lower.
alya_finance: confirm invoice flow: we issue invoice on effective date (signature) unless they provide signed PO referencing order form id and billing contact. net45 then applies from invoice date. if they need invoice to release funds earlier, they'll need to provide billing contact email + signed commitment.
emma_sales: BlueCrest procurement says their platform requires countersign only on their e-sign tool. any red flags?
todd_legal: fine as long as executed copy comes back and no automated edits happen. if their e-sign injects new terms via attachments, do not accept. request a pdf of the fully executed doc.
esign_bot: Heads up: when using third-party e-sign, our DocuSign connector won't record signature metadata automatically. Legal must manually confirm signer name + date.
leo_ps: i'll draft appendix for ingest endpoint + tenant isolation and post config steps for SRE. will add encryption and retention notes.
emma_sales: plan: i'll send counterproposal today with the deletion + penalty cap language and request their billing contact. @todd_legal please prepare the DPA redline. @alya_finance ready to approve net45 if billing contact + PO provided.
todd_legal: on it. will produce a redline we can share via tracked PDF. flag me if they push KMS/HSM key custody — that's product-level.
alya_finance: once we have PO + billing contact we can accept net45; otherwise require prepay.
emma_sales: thanks all — i'll update BlueCrest and loop back with their procurement reply. :rocket:
